subject: 松阳延庆寺塔
caption: 松阳 · 延庆寺塔
六面七级 · 底层副阶重檐
source_note: 选2022年近正面完整实照为实际生成输入；七层六面，底层副阶重檐使外轮廓共有八条檐线。保留现状木檐、回廊、铁塔刹，移除植被与道路。2014 panoramio远景仅作筛选，未输入最终生图。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one architectural illustration for the heritage collection 访古. Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER ONLY: the existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant delicate slightly organic thin black strokes, restrained detail, large white surfaces and quiet visual density. Image 2 is an actual photograph of the NAMED MONUMENT and is GEOMETRY ONLY.
Create sparse fine BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE, all surfaces and openings WHITE. Confident thin exterior contours and fewer finer interior structural lines. No solid black fills, no shadows, no gray shading, no hatching, no pencil grain, texture or gradients, no color. Simplify repetitive ornament; do not trace every brick, tile, rafter or weathered patch. Roof and wall surfaces should stay predominantly blank. Preserve the actual identifying geometry, proportions and present condition. Remove tourists, trees, foliage, vehicles, wires, signs, fences, surrounding buildings and sky. No text, calligraphy, labels, captions, dimension marks, watermark or border. A few short ground strokes only.
Portrait 1024x1536, whole tower and base occupy about 82% of canvas height with margins, full apex and footings uncut; centered near-frontal with minimal perspective.
SUBJECT: Yanqing Temple Pagoda in SONGYANG county, Zhejiang, China (松阳延庆寺塔), the actual 999–1002 tower in the photo. This is a SIX-SIDED HEXAGONAL pagoda, not an octagonal tower. It has SEVEN storeys. Crucial: the first/ground storey has a DOUBLE-EAVED projecting surrounding veranda, so the entire real tower shows EIGHT roof outlines: two broad closely spaced roofs at the very bottom, then SIX more roofed upper storeys. Copy this exact photographic count and rhythm. Do not mistake the ground-storey extra eave for an eighth full room.
Draw the slim hexagonal tower near frontal with full base, two lower veranda eaves, six upper roofs, and entire thin openwork iron finial. The ground veranda is broad and low with straight timber posts and central panel doors; both lower eave lines must remain visible one above the other. Above this the upper six floors are narrower and slightly tapering, each with a hexagonal walking balcony, simple horizontal railings, round-lobed arched doors/niches, small panel divisions and short timber bracket groups supporting gently-curved shallow roofs. Preserve the real roof overhang and modest corner lift, plus the thin finial support chains and loop/openwork at the upper tip. The main shaft is brick with restored timber eaves: reproduce current visible geometry without claiming every timber is original.
The photo shows the full architectural silhouette amid trees. Remove all vegetation, signs, paving paths and sky; depict the completed visible low platform and central step beneath the ground-floor doorway. Keep six-sided shape, seven actual storeys, eight eave outlines including the double-eaved first storey. Sparse delicate black contours, mostly blank white roof planes with NO full tile pattern. No black doors or filled shaded bracket undersides. No exaggerated ornate Chinese roof corners. Center the full tall tower in portrait 1024x1536 with all tips and plinth inside margins.

site_recommendation.name: 松阳延庆寺塔
site_recommendation.sub: 松阳 · 六面七级砖木塔
site_recommendation.year_note: 999为施工起年，1002为完成年；木檐等近现代修理不等同于宋代砖砌核心全部重建。
site_recommendation.place: 浙江 · 丽水 · 松阳
site_recommendation.coordinate_note: 塔体公开位置28°27′24.37″N、119°27′11.56″E换算，非Panoramio摄影位置。
site_recommendation.lede: 延庆寺塔的六角塔身逐级收分，平座回廊绕塔而设，底层以两重宽檐展开。细长铁刹立在七级砖木结构之上，呈现浙西南早期楼阁塔的形态。
facts: 塔于北宋咸平二年（999）动工，1002年完成；现条目按宋代砖砌核心登记。
塔为六面七级楼阁式砖木结构，底层副阶重檐，因此完整外观可数到八条檐线。
1983年启动重点维修、1991年竣工；今日木檐与回廊的维修历史须与北宋塔身区分。

quality_check.notes: 七层塔身、底层双檐、铁塔刹及柱础台阶均完整；屋面留白，六角形制未作八角说明。
